WITH year_total as ( select c_customer_id customer_id ,c_first_name customer_first_name ,c_last_name customer_last_name ,c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag ,c_birth_country customer_birth_country ,c_login customer_login ,c_email_address customer_email_address ,d_year dyear ,sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total ,'s' sale_type from customer ,store_sales ,date_dim where c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk group by c_customer_id ,c_first_name ,c_last_name ,c_preferred_cust_flag ,c_birth_country ,c_login ,c_email_address ,d_year union all select c_customer_id customer_id ,c_first_name customer_first_name ,c_last_name customer_last_name ,c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag ,c_birth_country customer_birth_country ,c_login customer_login ,c_email_address customer_email_address ,d_year dyear ,sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total ,'w' sale_type from customer ,web_sales ,date_dim where c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk group by c_customer_id ,c_first_name ,c_last_name ,c_preferred_cust_flag ,c_birth_country ,c_login ,c_email_address ,d_year ),
store_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    MAX(c.c_first_name) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1999) AS customer_first_name,
    MAX(c.c_last_name) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1999) AS customer_last_name,
    MAX(c.c_email_address) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1999) AS customer_email_address,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1998) AS s_first_year_total,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1999) AS s_second_year_total
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
  GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
),
web_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1998) AS w_first_year_total,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 1999) AS w_second_year_total
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
  GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
)
SELECT
  st.customer_id,
  st.customer_first_name,
  st.customer_last_name,
  st.customer_email_address
FROM store_totals st
INNER JOIN web_totals wt ON st.customer_id = wt.customer_id
WHERE st.s_first_year_total > 0
  AND wt.w_first_year_total > 0
  AND st.s_second_year_total IS NOT NULL
  AND wt.w_second_year_total IS NOT NULL
  AND (CASE WHEN wt.w_first_year_total > 0 THEN wt.w_second_year_total / wt.w_first_year_total ELSE 0.0 END)
      > (CASE WHEN st.s_first_year_total > 0 THEN st.s_second_year_total / st.s_first_year_total ELSE 0.0 END)
ORDER BY st.customer_id, st.customer_first_name, st.customer_last_name, st.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
